cases.title: A floor cleaner approaching in a narrow hallway
cases.review_note: Approved revised decks: eleven slides each. Before the threat appears, the actor knows he can escape in one direction (necessary) or five safe directions (unnecessary). Both people keep their own plates until the collision. The adult study includes this case.

cases.title: A heavy box tumbling down the stairs
cases.review_note: Approved revised decks: eleven slides each. Before the threat appears, the actor knows he can escape in one direction (necessary) or five safe directions (unnecessary). Both people keep their own plates until the collision. The adult study includes this case.

slides.text: This is Milo.
Milo has 8 cookies.
This is Sasha.
Sasha has 2 cookies.
Milo and Sasha are talking about school.

Milo knows he can get out
in only one direction.
Suddenly, a heavy floor cleaner rolls toward Milo!
There is nowhere to run except into Sasha!
Oh no! Milo runs into Sasha!
2 of Sasha’s cookies fall!
Milo still has 8 cookies. Sasha now has 0 cookies.

Milo and Sasha are talking about school.

Milo knows he can get out
in five different directions.
Suddenly, a heavy floor cleaner rolls toward Milo!

Milo can run four other ways
without running into Sasha!
Oh no! Milo runs into Sasha!
2 of Sasha’s cookies fall!
Milo still has 8 cookies. Sasha now has 0 cookies.
